verses.text: Axo winhaj Pilato ix chekan ik'jokb'at Jesús yik' b'at mak'jok.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sjalan setan jun q'uiix heb' winh soldado, ix yak'ank'e heb' winh skoronaok Jesús chi'. Ix yak'anoch jun k'apak heb' winh t'ay, k'ik' mutz'inak icha yik heb' rey.
Ix laj k'och heb' winh t'a stz'ey, ix stz'akan yal heb' winh t'ay: --Tzalajanh ach sreyal heb' israel, xchi heb' winh t'ay. Ix tz'itjib'at sat yuj heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix elta winhaj Pilato t'a sti' b'aj aykan heb' aj Judea chi'. Ix yalanelta winh t'a skal heb': --Ileknab'i, tik tzin ch'oxelta winh t'ayex, yik wach' tzeyojtakejeli to malaj jab'ok smul winh ix ilchaj wuuj, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ichato chi' ix elta Jesús t'a sti'. Anheja' ayk'e jun q'uiix chi' t'a sjolom, anheja' aypaxoch jun k'ik' mutz'inak k'apak chi' yuj. Ix yalanxielta winhaj Pilato chi' t'a heb': --Ina winh tik, xchi winh.

Ayik ix yilan heb' winh sat sakerdote yet' heb' winh stanhwumal templo yelk'och Jesús t'a sti' chi', ix k'e umnaj heb' winh yalani: --Kulusejk'e winh. Kulusejk'e winh, xchi heb' winh. Ix yalanpax winhaj Pilato chi' t'a heb': --Ik'ekb'at winh a ex tik, tze kulusank'e winh he ch'okoj. Xal in tik, malaj jab'ok smul winh tz'ilchaj wuuj, xchi winh.
Ix yalanpax heb' aj Judea chi' t'a winh: --Palta ay jun ley aykan t'ayonh. Yuj jun ley chi' yowalil ol miljokcham jun winh tik, yujto ix yaloch sb'a winh Yuninalok Dios, xchi heb'.
Axo ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Pilato chi', ix te xiwb'at winh.
Yuj chi' ix ochxik'och winh t'a yol sdespacho, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a Jesús: --¿B'ajtil kotnak ach jun? xchi winh t'ay. Palta maj tak'woklaj Jesús chi' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winh t'ay: --¿Tas yuj max ach tak'wi t'ayin? ¿Tom manh ojtakok to ay wopisio ach wak'anel t'a libre, ay pax wopisio ach in kulusank'ei? xchi winh t'ay.

Ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --Palta haton Dios ak'jinak opisio chi'. Tato maay, malaj alan jab'ok ik t'ayin. Yuj chi' a winh ix in ak'anoch t'a yol a k'ab', te ek'alto smul winh t'a ichanh, xchi t'a winh.

Ixlajwi yab'an juntzanh chi' winh, ix snaan winh tas syutej yak'anel Jesús chi' t'a libre. Axo heb' aj Judea chi', ix k'e umnaj heb' yalani: --Tato tzak'el winh t'a libre, ajk'ool ach t'a winh yajal t'a Roma syal chi'. Ha winh tik ix yaloch sb'a winh reyal. Palta a mach tz'alan icha chi', ajk'ool t'a winh yajal t'a Roma chi', xchi heb' t'a winh.

Ixlajwi yab'an jun chi' winh, ix yalan winh to tz'ik'jikot Jesús chi' b'aj ayek' winh chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix em k'ojan winh t'a sk'ojnub' b'aj sb'o yaj owal. Ha jun lugar chi', Gabata sb'i t'a hebreo. Syalelk'ochi, b'aj latz'b'ilem k'een k'een.

Ayik ix em k'ojan winh chi', wanxo yoch chimk'ualil. K'ik'anokxo sq'uinh heb' israel yik snaankot heb' tas aj yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto. Axo ix yalanpaxelta winh t'a skal heb' aj Judea chi': --Ina winh he reyal tik, xchielta winh t'a heb'.

Palta ix laj awaj chaanh heb' junelxo: --Chamokab' winh. Chamokab' winh. Kulusejk'e winh, xchi heb'. --¿Tom swak' kulusejk'e winh he reyal tik? xchi winh t'a heb'. Axo heb' winh sat sakerdote ix tak'wi: --Ha onh tik, anhej winh yajal t'a Roma ko reyal. Malaj junokxo, xchi heb' winh.
Ichato chi' ix ak'jioch Jesús t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yik skulusajk'ei. Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at Jesús chi' heb'.
Axo Jesús ix kuchan skulusal, ix ik'jib'at t'a jun lugar skuchan Gólgota t'a hebreo. Syalelk'ochi: B'aj Ay Sb'akil Jolom.
Ata' ix kulusajk'e Jesús yuj heb'. Ay chawanhxo heb' winh ix kulusajk'e yet'ok, jun winh t'a swach', junxo winh t'a sk'exanh, haxo t'a snanhal skulusal heb' winh chi' ix kulusajk'e Jesús chi'.

Axo winhaj Pilato chi' ix ak'an tz'ib'chajoch juntzanh lolonel t'a jun yune' chem te'. Ix yak'an ak'jokoch winh t'a sjolom skulusal Jesús chi'. Icha tik syal jun chi': Ha Jesús aj Nazaret, Sreyal heb' israel, xchi.

Ha jun lugar b'aj ix kulusajk'e Jesús chi', ha t'a ti' chonhab' ay. Yuj chi' tzijtum heb' israel ix ilan juntzanh lolonel chi'. Ha t'a hebreo, t'a griego yet' pax t'a latín, haton sti' heb' aj Roma, ata' ix tz'ib'chajochi.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh sat sakerdote t'a winhaj Pilato chi': --Oktom manhok Sreyal heb' israel ix ak' tz'ib'chajochok. Oktom tzak' tz'ib'chaj icha tik: Ha winh tik, ix yaloch sb'a winh Sreyalok heb' israel, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.
--Ha tas ix wak' tz'ib'chajok, skannhej icha chi', xchi winhaj Pilato chi' t'a heb' winh.

Axo heb' winh soldado, ayik manto skulusejk'e Jesús heb' winh, ix kichjiel spichul yuj heb' winh. Ix spukanek' heb' winh t'a spatik. Chanh poj ix aji. Junjun yik junjun heb' winh. Palta haxo jun kolxo spichul, jalb'ilkot t'a sjolom masanto t'a yoktak, malaj stz'isul.

Yuj chi' ix yal heb' winh icha tik: --Tekan a jun tik manh ol ko nhik'chitejb'ati. Wach' ama to skaq'ek ko suerte t'a yib'anh, yalnhej mach onh ol kik'a', xchi heb' winh. Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios, ayik yalannakkani: Ol spukek' in pichul heb' t'a spatik, ol yak'an suerte heb' t'a yib'anh junxo, xchi. Yuj chi' icha chi' ix yutej heb' winh soldado chi'.
Linhanoch ix snun Jesús t'a stz'ey te' kulus chi', ajun ix snulej ix yet'ok yet' ix María ix yetb'eyum winhaj Cleofas yet' ix María aj Magdala.

Ay pax ek' jun winh sk'ayb'um Jesús t'a stz'ey ix snun chi', haton jun winh te xajan yuj. Ayik ix iljikot heb' yuj Jesús, ix yalan t'a ix snun chi': --Nunin, a jun ayek' et' tik, icha une' tzutej, xchi t'a ix.

Ix lajwinhej chi', ix yalan t'a jun winh sk'ayb'um chi': --Ha ix in nun tik, icha a nun tzutej ix, xchi. Yuj chi', a jun winh sk'ayb'um chi' ix ik'ankanoch ix snun Jesús chi' t'a yol spat. Atax ta' kannak ix yet'ok.

Ixlajwi chi', yojtakxo Jesús to ix elk'och masanil tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a yib'anh. Yuj chi' ix yal icha tik: --Stakji wal in ti', xchi. Icha chi' ix yutej yalani yik tz'elk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios.
Ayek' jun chen winagre ta'. Ix yak'anoch jun tz'ub'lab' heb' t'a sjolom jun te' hisopo, ix slab'anem heb' t'a skal jun winagre chi', ix yak'anoch heb' t'a sti' Jesús chi'.
Ix stz'ub'an jun winagre chi', ix lajwi chi' ix yalani: --Toxo ix yik' sb'a smasanil, xchi. Ixlajwi chi', ix em nhojnaj schami.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', k'ik'anokxo tz'och sq'uinh heb' israel yik snaankot heb' tas aj yelnakkot heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto, sk'ual ik'oj ip yaj t'a heb'. Ha heb' winh aj Judea malaj snib'ej heb' winh skan sniwanil heb' kulusab'il t'a te' kulus chi', yujto a jun q'uinh sja chi', te niwan q'uinh syutej heb'. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' sk'an t'a winhaj Pilato to syak' mak'jok poj sb'akil sat spenek heb' winh, yik tz'ik'jiemta heb' t'a te' kulus chi'.
Yuj chi' ix k'och heb' winh soldado b'aj ix kulusajk'e heb' chi'. Ha heb' winh kulusalb'ilk'e yet' Jesús chi', ix mak'jipoj sb'akil sat spenek heb' winh.
Palta haxo yik ix k'och heb' winh t'a stz'ey Jesús chi', ix yilan heb' winh to chamnakxo, majxo smak'pojlaj sb'akil sat spenek chi' heb' winh.
Palta ay jun winh soldado ix tipanoch k'een slanza t'a skostil Jesús chi'. Yuj chi' ix elta usnaj chik' yet' ha ha'.
Ha in tik, ix wil wal juntzanh tik. Yuj chi' swak' testigoal in b'a yuj, yik ol eyak'och t'a he k'ool. Ha juntzanh tzin tz'ib'ejkan tik, te yel. Ha in tik wojtak to te yel swala'.
Ix uji juntzanh tik, yik tz'elk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a Slolonel Dios ayik syalan icha tik: Malaj junok sb'akil ol smak' poj heb', xchi.
Syalanpax junxo tik t'a Slolonel chi': Ol yil jun mach b'aj stipnakoch k'een lanza heb', xchi.

Ay jun winh skuchan José aj chonhab' Arimatea. Sk'ayb'um winh Jesús t'a k'ub'eltak, yujto xiw winh t'a heb' winh aj Judea. Xit' sk'anan spermiso winh t'a winhaj Pilato yik syik'emta sniwanil Jesús chi' winh t'a te' kulus, b'at smukan winh. Axo winhaj Pilato chi' ix ak'an spermiso winh yik'anemta. Yuj chi' ix yik'anb'at winh.

Ajun pax winhaj Nicodemo winh xit'nakek' sk'umej Jesús t'ak'walil yet'nak winh. Ay am oxeok arroba juntzanh suk'uq'ui sjab' skuchan mirra kalan yaj yet' junxo skuchan áloes yet'nak winhaj Nicodemo chi'.

Ix yik'anb'at sniwanil Jesús chi' heb' winh. Ix spichan heb' winh t'a jun k'apak. Ix yak'anoch jun suk'uq'ui sjab' chi' heb' winh t'ay, yujto icha chi' sley heb' israel chi' ayik smukan heb' chamnak heb'.
Axo t'a slak'anil b'aj ix kulusajk'e Jesús chi' ay jun awb'en te'. Ata' ay jun k'een k'een joyb'ilel yool. Ha jun k'een chi', manta junok chamnak tz'ak'jioch t'a yol k'een.
Axo jun sk'ual ik'oj ip, toxo syamchajochi. Yuj chi' ha t'a yol jun k'een chi' ix ak'jioch sniwanil Jesús chi', yujto lak'an ay k'een b'aj ix cham chi'.
